_instructions: Example project context for the software-development profile. Copy to my_project_context.json, edit, then run: babok run --profile software-development --context my_project_context.json
scope: Add a saved-payment-method flow to the checkout service and storefront so returning customers can pay without re-entering card details.
pain_points: Checkout abandonment is 22% above the 12-month baseline for returning customers
Support receives repeated complaints about re-entering payment details on every order
success_criteria: Checkout abandonment for returning customers ≤ industry baseline (9%) within 2 releases of go-live
constraints: No breaking change to the existing checkout-service public API
regulations: PCI-DSS scope must not expand — card data continues to be tokenised by the existing PSP
